subject: Novus AI — request for structured guardrail exception and one-time makegood
messages:
From: Sara Dane <sara.dane@novus.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@novus.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novus.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: conditional guardrail exception + initial makegood proposal

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the private deployment options. We have a couple of internal constraints that mean the standard rate card won't fit our FY29 planning without a supplemental concession.

High level:
- We expect a multi-year deployment (3 years) across inference and dedicated capacity.
- Forecast attached (Usage-forecast-novus.xlsx) shows a heavy ramp in Q1–Q3 2029.
- Our procurement committee is asking for a one-time onboarding credit and a guardrail on price increases for year 2 and 3.

Request:
1) 25% introductory discount on hosted inference unit pricing for the first 12 months (applied to token usage only).
2) A one-time onboarding credit of $120k to offset migration costs (Doc referenced: SoA link).
3) Contract language that caps list price increases to <= 5% year-over-year for years 2 and 3, or else a right to retreat to a negotiated escape clause.

We recognize this is non-standard. We are ready to commit to a 36-month term with a $1.2M annualized ARR target in exchange for flexibility above. Can your team route this up for approval? I copied Tom (platform lead) and procurement.

Attachments: Usage-forecast-novus.xlsx (forecast), high-level SoA link provided in procurement thread.

Best,
Sara
Sara Dane
Head of Cloud Platform, Novus AI
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Dane <sara.dane@novus.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional guardrail exception + initial makegood proposal

Sara — really appreciate the clarity and the forecast. High-level response: we want Novus to succeed and the commitment looks promising, but the three asks touch pricing guardrails and a sizable onboarding credit. I'll escalate internally with the numbers and a proposed structure that protects Redwood margins while giving Novus the predictability they need.

Proposal I plan to send to Sales Ops / Finance:
- Introductory discount: 20% for the first 12 months (applied to compute/hosting token units).
- Onboarding credit: $75k applied as a bill credit over the first 6 months unless usage thresholds are met earlier.
- Guardrail: cap list increases to 5%/yr; if usage growth falls below our committed baseline, a true-up will be required.

If you're open to 20% + $75k with a mutual SLA-based exit clause, I can get a quicker path to approval. I cc'd Marissa (commercial operations) to prep the formal exception packet for VP/CFO review. Expect an internal memo from us by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: NOVUS AI — exception memo for VP/CFO: recommended structure and financials (internal)

Team,

Attached: Novus-MAP-Draft-v2.pdf and redwood-pricing-matrix.png. Below is the exception memo I prepared for VP/CFO review. Please review and reply with edits. I will route to Marcus and the CFO desk once we align.

Summary: Novus AI requests a contract-level exception in exchange for a 36-month committed term with annualized ARR ~ $1.2M (year 1 ramp). They ask for a 25% introductory discount, $120k onboarding credit, and a cap on price increases.

Recommended commercial compromise (preserves unit economics while winning the deal):
- Approved concession (recommended):
  * Introductory discount: 22% off list for months 1–12 applied to hosted token units only.
  * Onboarding credit: $90,000 bill credit applied over months 1–6; remainder contingent on meeting Q2 2029 usage milestone (see Usage-forecast).
  * Price guardrail: cap list increases to 5%/yr; if actual usage in year 2 < 75% of forecasted baseline, Novus reimburses the delta at a 50% recovery factor (protects us vs. churn).
- Revenue impact modeling:
  * Year 1 expected recognized revenue: $820k (after applied discount and credits) vs. $1.2M ARR target.
  * Total credit exposure: $90k guaranteed + contingent $30k based on milestone (max $120k).
  * Gross margin delta (12 months): estimated -8% absolute (includes credits + discount).
- Strategic rationale: Novus is a reference customer in a vertical (enterprise content moderation) where low-latency VPC inference is a differentiator. Higher likelihood for multi-product expansion (dedicated pools + Optimize).

Ask: Marcus/Finance to approve the above concession path OR propose an alternate mix (e.g., lower discount + higher onboarding credit) and confirm whether CFO sign-off is required (I expect yes given credit size).

Attachments: Novus-MAP-Draft-v2.pdf (memo), redwood-pricing-matrix.png (rate impact chart), Usage-forecast-novus.xlsx (shared earlier).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-06T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NOVUS AI — exception memo for VP/CFO: recommended structure and financials (internal)

Marissa / team — thanks for the thoughtful memo and the financials. I reviewed the modeled P&L and the contingent recovery language; overall this is acceptable with the following edits and final conditions before I route to CFO for signature: 

Conditions for my approval to escalate to CFO (sign-off packet):
1) Reduce guaranteed onboarding credit to $75k (apply $15k contingent that vests if Q2 2029 usage >= 110% of baseline).
2) Change introductory discount to 20% guaranteed; allow an additional 2% incentive (total 22%) if Novus executes a Dedicated capacity addendum within the first 12 months.
3) Add a minimum monthly committed baseline (MUB) schedule in the SOW with quarterly true-ups; if Novus misses MUB for two consecutive quarters, Redwood may unwind price guardrail and revert to list pricing with 30 days' notice.
4) Legal to add a mutual exit clause tied to documented security/sovereignty failures discovered during deployment.

If Legal confirms the SOW language and Commercial Ops updates the billing schedule, I will present this packet to CFO for approval. Please prepare a one-page executive summary for CFO that calls out: net ARR delta, max credit exposure ($90k), payback assumptions, and reference value (go-to-market callouts).

I will set aside time with CFO at 10:00am PT on 2028-10-09 to review the packet — please have final materials by 17:00 PT on 2028-10-08.

Marcus Lin
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
